title: P6 Shipping audit and authorized corrections — 2026-10-09

sections.title: Independent audit verdict and owner authority
sections.text:
Initial independent audit of baseline 6a0a37d: RED (3 Major). P6.1–P6.7 were implemented by other sessions; this session performed one audit without subagents. Owner explicitly authorized execution, commit and push: «и ты же исполняешь его, потом коммит и пуш». Corrections follow this verdict as execution work, not a second independent review.

All three findings repaired. Final executor verification: GREEN, no open findings in the requested correction scope. This is repair verification by the executor, not a second independent audit. Historical P6 execution results/checks are preserved; current correction evidence is recorded below and in phase notes.

sections.title: Findings and owning items
sections.text:
A1 — Major — P6.1. packages/shipping/src/Rates/Internal/RateCodec.php:66–92. Stored-rate decode catches only UnsupportedContribution and InvalidRateConfig; a RuntimeException/Error in contribution resolution, version(), upgrade() or normalize() escapes MethodPricer (decode is outside its price try/catch) and MethodRows. One broken plugin therefore aborts all options/explain and admin method reads instead of marking its tariff unsupported (SHP-05). Repair: contain every plugin loading failure on the read path; keep writes strict; regression tests through codec, options and admin reads.

A2 — Major — P6.6. packages/shipping/src/Bookings/Internal/CarrierShipmentBooking.php:62–66,101–111. The mutable current method is checked before the journal. Book a shipment, archive the method or change its carrier, then repeat the identical BookShipment: MethodArchived/CarrierMismatch prevents returning the durable result. For unknown/expired pending, the same change prevents Carrier::find and strands a possibly existing shipment. Repair: the journal is authoritative for existing booked/recovery attempts; method validation applies to a first/new rejected attempt. Preserve fingerprint conflict, lease and fencing protections; unavailable original carrier fails closed.

A3 — Major — P6.6. packages/shipping/src/Bookings/Internal/CarrierShipmentBooking.php:163–176; packages/shipping/src/Bookings/Internal/BookingJournal.php:230–238. isMeta accepts scalar string keys/values containing NUL, and JSON encoding succeeds; PostgreSQL jsonb rejects \u0000. A carrier-created shipment then raises QueryException during finish and stays pending rather than unknown with shipping.invalid_carrier_result. Evidence: isolated PostgreSQL query select a JSON object with note=\u0000 cast to jsonb returns unsupported Unicode escape sequence. Repair: validate PostgreSQL-representable UTF-8 metadata before finish, on both book and find paths; regression tests assert unknown state and no event.

sections.title: Executed corrections and verification
sections.text:
A1 — fixed in RateCodec: contribution resolution, version, upgrade and normalize are contained on stored-data reads; writes remain strict. Added BrokenLoadingRate and regression tests for version/normalize/upgrade, plus public list/explain/admin behavior.
A2 — fixed under accepted D30: BookingJournal.claim validates create/rejected attempts inside the claim transaction; validation failure rolls back. Booked replay is resolved before current method/carrier lookup; recover uses the original payload/carrier. Added archive/carrier-change/uninstalled-carrier replay tests, archive/carrier-change recovery for unknown and expired pending, rejected validation, and missing-original-carrier recovery followed by successful recovery after reinstall.
A3 — fixed: carrier metadata must be JSON-encodable scalars with string keys, without NUL in keys or values. Book/find invalid results are journaled unknown with shipping.invalid_carrier_result and no ShipmentBooked event.

Behavioral reproduction before changes: 15 failed, 46 passed across three targeted test files. After changes: 61/61 passed; one further missing-carrier recovery regression is included in final suite. Final acceptance commands all exit 0:
- scripts/php84 composer lint:check — passed.
- scripts/php84 composer analyse — no errors (746 source files).
- scripts/php84 composer refactor:check — no changes.
- pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 54329 && scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --testsuite=Shipping,Arch --compact — 323 passed, 1053 assertions, including booking/zone concurrency.

No core/public signatures, wire formats, migrations or dependencies changed. Updated docs/architecture/{api,decisions,invariants}.md, knowledge/shipping-design and plans/ACTIVE.md. Evidence comes from isolated commerz_test; raw command logs are /tmp/commerz-p6-{regression-before,regression-after,lint,analyse,refactor,tests}.log in this session. No second audit or subagents.
